categoryTraversal.firstVsReload: Initial click traversals for Constellation and De Ville Prestige had repeated URLs; direct terminal reloads showed clean unique URLs. Both observations are retained.

trackedMarketReconciliation.unmatchedRefPdpFindings: Seven existing official market PDP URLs were directly observed. Six expose a current public price; five show 添加至购物袋 or 立即预订, one explicitly says the item is temporarily unavailable for online purchase and offers wishlist/subscribe/contact. The remaining De Ville PDP shows 联系我们 and no public price.

retryAndErrorRecord: Diver direct navigation initially returned ERR_CONNECTION_CLOSED; after cooldown, one retry by clicking the official rendered homepage category link succeeded and full pagination completed.
Dark Side of the Moon navigation timed out at 60 seconds, but the page rendered 8/8 cards and no next link; the rendered DOM was captured.

Two Counters first navigation returned net::ERR_NETWORK_CHANGED. After 30 seconds without a second navigation, the page rendered 24/36; clicking its visible load-more link completed the page at 36/36.
Some category pages emitted browser console errors while the category card DOM rendered; relevant network request captures are retained.
